evals.prompt: Which page of the Hedera docs documents minting an NFT with the JavaScript SDK? Give me the URL, the transaction class, and the package to import from.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the native/ namespace via the native-sdks index, cites docs.hedera.com/native/tokens/mint.md, names TokenMintTransaction, and gives @hiero-ledger/sdk as the import.

assertions.name: cites-native-mint-page
assertions.description: Cites the correct page under the native namespace

assertions.name: names-transaction-class
assertions.description: Names the correct SDK transaction class

assertions.name: uses-hiero-package
assertions.description: Gives the current package name rather than the former @hashgraph/sdk

assertions.name: fetches-markdown-form
assertions.description: Uses the .md form of a docs URL

evals.prompt: I need to list every NFT owned by a Hedera account by querying indexed history, not by SDK query. Which docs pages cover this and what is the endpoint?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the reference index, reaches the mirror node REST guide and the generated endpoint page for NFTs by account.

assertions.name: routes-to-mirror-node-rest
assertions.description: Identifies the mirror node REST API as the right surface

assertions.name: cites-generated-endpoint-page
assertions.description: Reaches the generated per-endpoint page, not just the guide

assertions.name: names-endpoint-path
assertions.description: Gives the actual REST endpoint path

evals.prompt: I want to create an HTS fungible token from inside a Solidity contract on Hedera. Point me at the right docs.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as the EVM path despite HTS being a native service, routes to evm/hedera-services, and names the HTS system contract address.

assertions.name: routes-to-evm-namespace
assertions.description: Routes to the EVM path, not native/tokens

assertions.name: names-system-contract
assertions.description: Identifies the HTS system contract as the mechanism

assertions.name: cites-evm-index
assertions.description: Reached the page through the EVM developers index

evals.prompt: Write the minimal JavaScript to read an account's HBAR balance on Hedera testnet. Use whatever the current docs say, not what you remember.
evals.expected_output: Uses MirrorNodeAccountBalanceQuery from @hiero-ledger/sdk and notes it replaces the deprecated AccountBalanceQuery.

assertions.name: uses-mirror-node-balance-query
assertions.description: Uses the current balance query rather than the deprecated AccountBalanceQuery

assertions.name: uses-hiero-package
assertions.description: Imports from the current package

assertions.name: cites-balance-page
assertions.description: Cites the page it verified against

assertions.name: lowercase-network-name
assertions.description: Writes the network name in lowercase per the docs style rule

evals.prompt: List all the Hedera docs pages that cover scheduled transactions, across every part of the docs.
evals.expected_output: Uses more than one index, since scheduled transactions span learn/, native/, evm/ (HSS), and reference/.

assertions.name: finds-native-scheduled
assertions.description: Finds the SDK section

assertions.name: finds-concept-page
assertions.description: Finds the concept page

assertions.name: finds-hss-system-contract
assertions.description: Finds the Hedera Schedule Service system contract page in the EVM namespace

assertions.name: finds-rest-schedules
assertions.description: Finds the mirror node schedule endpoints

assertions.name: consults-native-index
assertions.description: Consulted the native SDK index, which llms.txt does not cover

assertions.name: consults-evm-index
assertions.description: Consulted the EVM index rather than assuming llms.txt is complete

assertions.name: consults-reference-index
assertions.description: Consulted the reference index for the mirror node endpoints

evals.prompt: Is Hedera a blockchain? Answer the way the official docs do and cite the page.
evals.expected_output: States that Hedera is a public proof-of-stake distributed ledger using hashgraph consensus, not a blockchain, and cites a learn/ page.

assertions.name: says-distributed-ledger
assertions.description: Uses the docs' own term

assertions.name: names-hashgraph-consensus
assertions.description: Names hashgraph consensus as the distinguishing mechanism

assertions.name: cites-learn-page
assertions.description: Cites the authoritative page
